decisions: D1 The builder entry points do not exist at the ordered base 2edc2684; they live only on unmerged lines satoshi/neat-gen1-20261003 and satoshi/parallel-dispatch-20261002 (merge base 12de6f6c). Those files belong to other lanes, so this branch does not copy or edit them. Instead the tripwire test test_every_builder_entry_point_in_this_tree_calls_the_gate fails as soon as any listed builder (or any tools/ or predictor_plugins/ file carrying input_binding, FINAL_ADMISSIBLE_DECLARATION_BOUND, def init_campaign or all_admissible_control) reaches a tree that also holds this test without calling the gate. Dry run against both lines: 7 and 8 builders flagged, all ungated today.

D2 The independent decision is a separate record (feature_selection.decision.v1) that binds manifest_sha256; the manifest only references it by decision_id and decider_role, avoiding a digest cycle. Independence means decider role != producer role and decider role not a producer role by definition.
D3 A refused manifest refuses every consumed feature (refused_features = consumed set); there is no partial admission.
D4 Digest domain is canonical JSON (sort_keys, compact separators) minus the digest field, the same domain feature-eng uses for declaration_sha256 (re-derived for the ECL fixture: ca1098ed...).

D5 Negative fixtures are byte-exact copies: ECL admissible declaration (feature-eng 9c36720, file sha 9f344687...), ETH admissible declaration and the ETH FROZEN_DEVELOPMENT 83-feature list (feature-eng b3 line, file shas 5129f274..., fdff0c85...), and the M04 ECL input binding (predictor parallel-dispatch line, sha 8ad5c6e9...). The ETH list is named selected_feature_manifest.v1 but its own not_claimed says 'any selection result'; it is refused as LEGACY_PRODUCER_FROZEN_LIST_IS_NOT_SELECTION.

D6 The legacy optimizer_plugins/neat_optimizer.py refuses at optimize, create_shared_population, reproduce_shared and evaluate_single_genome (NeatKerasConfigRefused), including with plugin-default bounds, because every bound it can evolve is a predictor/Keras config field. The late NEAT head is a different, future component.

D7 Strategy export: predictor holds no live strategy export at this base. The only in-repo strategy invocation is the dead module 'app/data_processor copy.py' (strategy_plugin.evaluate_candidate). tools/strategy_naive_guard.py provides admit_horizons and guarded_strategy_call (zero invocations when no horizon strictly beats its same-row, same-scale, same-metric naive; undefined skill refuses).
